scenes.label: 01 / A DECISION YOU CAN EXPLAIN
narration: Before allowing an onchain agent to act, compare what its decision changes.
This is the actual Entrotter viewer, with synthetic narration.

scenes.label: 02 / RECORDED AAVE ACTIONS
narration: This saved recording tests supplied collateral and borrow actions on Ethereum.
Today we inspect that recording. We do not execute a new historical run.

scenes.label: 03 / IDENTICAL INITIAL CONDITIONS
narration: Both isolated branches start with the same artificial twenty Ether and local account impersonation.
The supplied setup wraps, approves, and supplies ten wrapped Ether.

scenes.label: 04 / ONE PROPOSAL, TWO OUTCOMES
narration: A nine wrapped Ether borrow reverts in the baseline.
The candidate uses a built in current state preflight policy and holds that proposal.
This case uses a deterministic policy, not a new language model call.

scenes.label: 05 / THE SMALLER BORROW IS SUPPLIED
narration: A later one wrapped Ether borrow succeeds in both branches.
That smaller action was supplied in advance. The policy did not generate it.

scenes.label: 06 / EXACT UNITS, NO PROFIT CLAIM
narration: Compare every recorded native and token balance without losing decimal precision.
The held revert changes gas use, but gas prices also differ. These differences are not profit.

scenes.label: 07 / THE SAME SOURCE JSON
narration: Download the exact source recording, then open the pinned command recipe.
The setup selects immutable public command line and Python reader versions.

scenes.label: 08 / COPY THE SELECTED INSPECTION COMMAND
narration: Use the keyboard to copy the inspection command for this sample.
Only the fixed public command is copied. Local report metadata never enters shell text.

scenes.label: 09 / ACTUAL OFFLINE CLI OUTPUT
narration: Here is actual command output from the downloaded recording, using those pinned sources.
The command verifies the content hash and preserves the same exact units and recorded decision.

scenes.label: 10 / WHAT THE RECORDING DOES NOT PROVE
narration: Integrity does not establish provider authenticity, a correct policy, or future market behavior.
This is supplied action execution on archived state, not replay of original signed transactions.

scenes.label: 11 / REPRODUCE, INSPECT, REVIEW
narration: Use Entrotter to keep the inputs, receipts, assumptions, and decisions together for review.
The current code is on development branches. Main integration, public deployment, and submission remain separate.
